purpose: 구출 및 캐릭터 수집 UI 콘셉트 4장

prompts.title: 구출 대상 명부
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity PC game UI screenshot, landscape 16:9 at high resolution, edge-to-edge game screen, no device frame, no collage. Original game HEX BLADE: male mech pilot rescues adult female pilots fused with biomechanical eldritch machines. Serious industrial science-fiction with restrained cosmic horror. It is an attractive character-collection action game, not a mobile gacha store. Visual system: near-black blue-gray, ivory-white typography, subdued teal functional highlights, amber target highlights, restrained dark crimson for hostile organic tissue. Crisp large legible Korean interface typography, strong hierarchy, generous spacing, thin technical borders, minimal decoration. Main scene can have sophisticated hand-painted cel-shaded 3D environments and attractive detailed anime character art. Adult women in practical fully clothed flight suits and jackets, distinct confident faces, no childlike proportions, no sexual framing, no exposed wounds. The three recurring identities are: EIRIN/에이린, adult woman with long platinum-silver hair, straight fringe, teal eyes, ivory cropped flight jacket over black high-collar flight suit, small amber tag 06; MIRA/미라, adult woman with short charcoal hair and one dark red streak, gray-green eyes, navy armored flight suit with red shoulder patch; LIA/리아, adult woman with shoulder-length muted lavender hair, amber eyes, black technical flight suit and teal harness. Other roster members are SENA/세나 auburn-haired, NOA/노아 black-haired with glasses, YUNA/유나 dark brown ponytail. These are original adult characters. Do not add currencies, stars, loot boxes, rarity tiers, premium purchase buttons, sexualized outfits, gibberish paragraphs, or a fantasy-demon theme. Use only the supplied short labels; optional nonlinguistic ticks instead of fake tiny text.
Screen 01: choose a desired pilot before rescue. State: early campaign, owned 0/2, selected future target Eirin who is deep behind prerequisites. Left 58% a dossier browser: title "구출 대상 명부", six handsome large portrait cards in 3 columns x 2 rows, faces all visible even when inaccessible; exact card names "미라", "세나", "리아", "노아", "유나", "에이린". Mira and Sena have a small "진입 가능" label, deeper portraits subtle lock icon, Eirin has thin amber selection outline and label "구출 목표". Right 42% a large beautiful three-quarter Eirin character illustration down to thigh, strong eye contact, with a faint faded biomechanical silhouette far behind for contrast, not obstructing face. Above her "에이린" and small "EIRIN / 06"; below short metadata "중앙 격리 구역", "선행 작전 2개". A broad amber primary button bottom right "구출 목표로 지정", a quieter "음성 기록". Header tabs "명부" selected, "작전도", "격납고". Top right "안정화 슬롯 0 / 2" with TWO empty slot indicators. Bottom subdued route preview "미라 → 리아 → 에이린". Strong premium PC character dossier design, restrained elegant, attractive faces carry the screen. All displayed text accurately Korean.
